market_summary: During the London session, EURUSD and GBPUSD have recovered above their session VWAPs but remain constrained inside their session Value Areas, trading adjacent to their respective POCs and facing Session High resistance without breakout RVOL. BTCUSD remains structurally bearish beneath its session VWAP, EMA50, and Value Area Low, yet is currently consolidating above recent lows without momentum confirmation. All three assets are in low-edge consolidation zones, favoring HOLD.

Inside VA directly at POC with neutral CVD warrants patience.

Given the bearish CVD divergence and resistance confluence near VAH/Session High, HOLD is prudent.

1) VP: Price is below VAL (73416.41) and well below POC (73541.61), indicating established value rejection. 2) CVD is BEARISH (-0.03, flat slope). 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Price is firmly below VWAP (73633.66) and EMA50 (73653.70) with a bearish slope. 5) Consolidating near the lower half of ATR envelope (lower band at 73137.16). 6) RVOL is low at 0.987 with zero yellow spikes. 7) The forming bar is struggling to push through resistance at S/R 73386.8 / VAL 73416.41, but lacks a fresh breakdown trigger or volume expansion, warranting a HOLD until a cleaner break or sweep of Session Low (73166.0).
